company_name: JIN ZHOU SEMICON NEW MATERIAL CO.,LTD
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides critical materials used in the fabrication of wafers and other substrates, essential for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Jin Zhou Semicon New Material Co., Ltd specializes in producing advanced semiconductor materials, focusing on various fusion methods for ingot manufacturing. Their products are crucial for the semiconductor value chain, offering high-quality materials for wafer and substrate fabrication.
capabilities: Electrical continuous fusion for ingot manufacturing
Drawing techniques for transparent and translucent materials
Electrical rotated fusion for opaque substrates
Flaming fusion for clear and opaque ingots
